Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExternalRedactionFinding, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractWithExternalRedaction } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { bytes: Uint8Array.from([116, 111, 107, 101, 110, 45, 55, 52, 50, 57, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 32, 97, 108, 105, 99, 101, 64, 101, 120, 97, 109, 112, 108, 101, 46, 99, 111, 109, 46]), filename: "external-findings.txt", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" };
  const result = await extractWithExternalRedaction(input, undefined, [{ label: "inspection_token", score: 0.99, text: "token-7429" } as ExternalRedactionFinding], "unicode_code_points", 8);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
}

void main();
```
